claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) describes Yeti and Bigfoot as the same semi-subterranean, telepathic creature, usually 3–4 meters tall.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says Sasquatch use hidden underground passages and may attack humans as habitat loss limits food.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Anéeka says the Dyatlov Pass deaths were probably a human attack by a hostile local tribe, with radioactive clothing linked to a nearby plant accident.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the evidence available to them was limited.

review_flags: The source contains contradictory explanations of the Dyatlov deaths: Swaruu (9) alleges a Yeti released by Reptilians (p0008), while Anéeka later favors a human tribal attack (p0013,p0021).
coverage_gaps: Sasquatch interactions with cetaceans and lunar frequencies
